plugin.name: stars
plugin._long: A star field over the whole screen until toggled off: a flight through space or a twinkling night sky. The desktop stays usable.

option.name: toggle
option._long: Starts the star field; it stays until the binding is used again. Also available as the IPC method stars/toggle.

option.name: mode
option._long: Flight through space (stars stream outwards from the centre) or a calm, twinkling sky.

option.name: star_size
option._long: Radius of the nearest stars in pixels; far stars are smaller.

option.name: speed
option._long: Flight and twinkling speed in percent (100 = normal).

option.name: darken
option._long: Darkens the screen behind the stars, in percent (0 = off, at most 90).
